WITH station_avg AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS a
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS b
  FROM station_avg
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s.a, s.a - o.b AS diff
  FROM station_avg AS s
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o
  WHERE o.b IS NOT NULL
    AND s.a > o.b
)
SELECT AVG(a), AVG(diff)
FROM step3
